description: K01 candidate contract snapshot for the first Kimi-routed APIs. Derived by hand from the official gateway describe documents captured locally. This file is a review candidate only: nothing loads it at runtime unless a config explicitly points kimi_integration.contract_snapshot at it, and live calls stay disabled regardless. Field-level unknowns are recorded as null with a reason instead of guessed values.

param_types.a_share_ticker_list: comma-separated, 1..max_items entries, each ^[0-9]{6}\.(SH|SZ|BJ)$; first batch is A-share only
param_types.statement_selector: comma-separated subset of {all, balance_sheet, income_statement, cash_flow}; aliases bs/is/cf normalized before validation
param_types.report_period: 8 digits: YYYY followed by one of 0331, 0630, 0930, 1231
param_types.search_query: natural-language query, max 200 chars, must not contain local paths or credential-like tokens
param_types.virtual_artifact_name: host-generated only; caller input rejected; value never reflects a real local path

apis.purpose: Daily OHLCV background around a public event; adjustment-basis verification. Not an intraday stream.

result_contract.rows_field: csv rows inside files[] content; max 1000 rows enforced by client

volume_unit.reason: contract document does not state share vs lot vs amount

currency.reason: not stated; CNY assumed for A-shares but unverified

source_time.reason: response envelope carries no explicit source timestamp field

realtime_capability.reason: this API is D/W/M/Q/Y historical only; realtime is a separate API not in first batch

notes: Contract says omitting adjust makes A-shares forward-adjusted; client requires explicit adjust so the basis is always recorded.
Default query for 'most recent price' per contract is past 5 days; the host template must still pass explicit dates.

apis.purpose: Announcement candidates and original-document entry points. Metadata only; official originals still enter through the evidence vault import path.

max_rows_per_response.reason: contract does not state pagination limits

correction_linkage.reason: whether corrections reference the original sequence number is not documented

notes: Returned PDF URLs are discovery leads, never proof of a downloaded or verified official original.
Default window when dates omitted is 'most recent month'; host templates must always pass explicit dates.

cumulative_basis.reason: A-share statements are typically year-to-date cumulative; contract does not confirm the basis per column

restatement_policy.reason: whether re-requesting an old period returns the restated version is undocumented

notes: A-share cumulative reporting differs from US single-quarter conventions; downstream must not infer quarterly deltas without an explicit basis statement.
Statement aliases bs/is/cf are normalized to canonical names before send.

apis.purpose: News and event-lead discovery. Only metadata/excerpts within granted rights enter the pipeline; no full-text scraping by default.
notes: Dongcai contract also offers report-generation and analysis APIs; those stay off the whitelist and are rejected as unsupported for this project.
The query text itself is external data egress: minimal symbol/topic only, never full workpapers.
